name: Vercel React best practices
author: Vercel

newRules.title: No request data in server module scope
newRules.text: Server components, route handlers and Server Actions keep request- and user-scoped data in function scope (or `React.cache` / request context), never in mutable module-level variables — concurrent renders share the module and can serve one user's data to another (PERF-27). *Enforced by:* semgrep + review lens.
newRules.modeReason: placed with quick rule NEXT-6 and no client-only signal
